title: Figures 31-32: LACE propellant weight vs. flight speed; FDL-7 with KLIN cycle inlet
description: Figure 31 is a line chart titled "Propellant Weight" plotting propellant weight (tons, 0-300) against flight speed along trajectory (ft/sec, 0-30,000) for "LACE Constant OWE," "LACE Actual OWE" and "Rocket Constant OWE"; caption: "Figure 31. LACE Air-Breathing Rocket Reduces Gross Liftoff Weight by 150 Metric Tons and Uses Existing Rocket Engines." Figure 32 combines a side-view vehicle drawing with a schematic labeled "Turbo Pump," "Oxygen," "Hydrogen," "Expander Cycle Rocket," "Turbojet" and "Inlet Heat Exchanger"; caption: "Figure 32. The FDL-7 Class of Vehicles With An Anthony DuPont Variable Capture and a Retractable Inlet Tested to Mach 5 Employing an Air-Breathing KLIN Cycle Rocket."
